title: Tajweed terms — مُصْطَلَحَات
description: Mixed Arabic/English fixture: each line must pick its own direction.
source: Test fixture, not a real quiz.

questions.text: Which rule applies to النُّونُ السَّاكِنَةُ before بَاء?
questions.explanation: The nūn turns into a hidden mīm, which is called الإِقْلَاب.

questions.text: Which direction does Arabic script run?

options.text: Right to left — مِنَ الْيَمِينِ إِلَى الْيَسَارِ

questions.explanation: Arabic is written right to left, so the quiz container gets dir="rtl".
